text: {"36":{"about":["rustc_ast_lowering"],"refers":[],"why":"AST-to-HIR lowering performs desugaring of syntax such as loops and async functions."},"37":{"about":["rustc_infer","rustc_trait_selection","rustc_hir_analysis","rustc_hir_typeck"],"refers":["rustc_middle"],"why":"These crates implement inference, trait resolution, and HIR type checking, while rustc_middle defines HIR."},"38":{"about":["rustc_hir_analysis"],"refers":["rustc_middle"],"why":"HIR type lowering into the compiler's internal Ty representation is implemented by rustc_hir_analysis, while the representations are defined in rustc_middle."},"39":{"about":["rustc_hir_analysis","rustc_hir_typeck"],"refers":[],"why":"These crates implement the type-checking work that verifies program type safety and correctness."},"40":{"about":["rustc_mir_build","rustc_borrowck"],"refers":["rustc_middle"],"why":"rustc_mir_build constructs THIR and lowers HIR into MIR, which rustc_borrowck consumes for borrow checking; rustc_middle defines the IRs."}}
